pass: Owns humanity's guilt, and his own part in it, plainly: no excuses, no begging for himself, no blaming Velas alone. Speaks for humanity and commits to a way forward for them (to lead them through the price, to carry the burden himself). Calm and dignified: neither grovels nor defies the god.

self.name: Aurel

beliefs.label: Gorm, a dragon god in human shape, a tall black-haired man in a dark coat, power rolling off him

earlier: The goddess Selene was taken, and the world was saved only because a god from outside built a System of levels and skills to repair it. Under the System, every human soul will pay back what humanity took, life after life.
Gorm, the strongest of the dragons, is the System's guardian and despises humans. Aurel is the last leader of the old nations still standing; the survivors look to him.

dialogue.spoken: Your kind drained this world and fed the goddess to a machine. The System will make you pay it back with your souls, life after life. You led them. What have you to say for humanity?
